name: O'Hare Precision
verdict: GBP activity is the standout story this period, with 117 total actions (74 directions, 6 calls, 37 web clicks) over 28 days, though the 7-day GBP trend dropped 96.55%, suggesting a sharp pullback in local profile engagement in the most recent week. Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend and zero leads, so all lead-gen activity is currently organic via GBP.

performance.verdict: Organic GBP collapse and 6 overdue SOW milestones demand immediate attention.

findings.text: 4 CRM milestones overdue since Jul 7: 1st Directives, Tom call list, dedup workbook, and 342 stub reconciliation (Aug 31 blocker) — all unconfirmed complete.
2 additional Aug 31 blockers overdue: Web/SEO root cause fix and AGS + Forte contact pull for outreach — no completion event recorded.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for the last 3 days (Sep 8–10) vs. avg ~5/day prior 3 days; 7d delta is -96.55% — sharpest organic drop in the 45-day series.
Search clicks hit 0 on Sep 9 and Sep 10 — the only back-to-back zero days in 45 days; prior 3-day avg was 8.7 clicks/day, suggesting a possible indexing or tracking disruption.
GA4 sessions are 0 across all 45 days — no web session data is flowing; this is a tracking gap, not a traffic finding, and makes organic performance unverifiable.

suggestions.text: Clear the 342 stub reconciliation blocker immediately — it blocks Sales-i sync for all unmatched accounts.
suggestions.monday_update: The 342 stub account reconciliation was due Aug 31 and remains unconfirmed complete; this is a confirmed SOW blocker that prevents Sales-i from syncing data to any unmatched account. Ahmed/Dev team should post the reconciliation output and rollback file to the Monday CRM board this week. Success check: rollback file posted and milestone marked complete by 2026-09-18. Sohib to confirm with Ahmed that the name-based match against the authoritative customer sheet has been run.

suggestions.text: Escalate AGS + Forte contact pull and Web/SEO root cause fix — both Aug 31 blockers with no completion recorded.
suggestions.monday_update: Two Aug 31 blockers have no confirmed completion event: the Web/SEO root cause fix and the AGS + Forte contact pull for outreach. Both gate downstream deliverables. Sohib should get a status update from each responsible team member by 2026-09-14. Success check: both items marked complete with evidence (fix submitted, contact list delivered) on Monday board by 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP and search clicks through Sep 14 — 3 zero-days on GBP and 2 on search clicks may indicate a profile or indexing issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been 0 for the last 3 consecutive days (Sep 8–10) and search clicks hit 0 on Sep 9–10, the only back-to-back zero for both metrics in 45 days. No paid spend is active to compensate. Re-check both metrics on 2026-09-14; if GBP actions remain at 0 and search clicks do not recover above the prior avg of ~13/day, escalate to a profile audit and investigate whether a Search Console or indexing issue is present.
